detailed_description: The target video is a realistic live-action period drama in a vertical 9:16 frame, with restrained natural light, tactile period materials, and observational camera movement. <Subject 1> places <Subject 2> in the foreground and Sue at the stair entrance with the dusty blank canvas between them. At 0.00 to 2.00 seconds Behrman still looks down at the brush after Sue has finished reporting, while Sue holds her ground. At 2.00 to 3.00 seconds he drops the brush onto the table with a sharp motion and lifts his head. Behrman (S4), an elderly man with a rough resonant voice, says: <d>[Chinese] 叶子掉了，人就跟着掉？这是哪一种蠢法？</d> From 3.00 to 7.20 seconds he turns fully toward Sue, and the lamp cuts a clear edge around the blank canvas. From 7.20 to 8.00 seconds the two hold their positions. Keep the camera at a restrained shoulder-height medium close-up with a slight lateral move from the brush to Behrman's frontal gaze; one continuous take with no cut. No non-diegetic subtitles, captions, or dialogue text overlays appear at any moment. Continuity locks: faded blue-green high-collar blouse; worn dark-blue wool coat with paint-stained cuffs.
overall_soundscape: Amber lamp hum, brush striking wood, Behrman's rough voice, faint stairwell room tone, and a distant cough above.
